## 3. Example alert reports (generated from the explanation only, no labels)

**portscan**
```
ALERT  10.0.0.39 flagged as malicious (score 1.00)
Because: 10 of the 10 most influential flows go from 10.0.0.39 to 1 host(s) over 10 distinct destination port(s) (median 87 packets/s, median duration 0.006s) -> port-scan-like pattern.
Key traffic features: Destination port (0.01), Bwd packets/s (0.01), Protocol (0.01)
Suggested action: Block or rate-limit the source and review the probed hosts for exposed services.
```

**dos**
```
ALERT  10.0.0.8 flagged as malicious (score 1.00)
Because: 10 of the 10 most influential flows go from 10.0.0.8 to 1 host(s) over 1 distinct destination port(s) (median 373 packets/s, median duration 0.056s) -> flood-like pattern.
Key traffic features: Flow packets/s (0.95), Flow duration (0.01), Fwd packet length (0.01)
Suggested action: Rate-limit the source at the edge; check the target server for degraded service.
```

**bruteforce**
```
ALERT  10.0.0.26 flagged as malicious (score 1.00)
Because: 10 of the 10 most influential flows go from 10.0.0.26 to 1 host(s) over 1 distinct destination port(s) (median 9 packets/s, median duration 2.229s) -> brute-force-like pattern.
Key traffic features: Destination port (0.07), Flow duration (0.02), Bwd packets/s (0.01)
Suggested action: Lock the targeted account/service and block the source after confirming the login failures.
```

**infiltration**
```
ALERT  10.0.2.62 flagged as malicious (score 1.00)
Because: 10 of the 10 most influential flows go from 10.0.2.62 to 8 host(s) over 3 distinct destination port(s) (median 20 packets/s, median duration 4.091s) -> lateral-movement-like pattern.
Key traffic features: Flow duration (0.06), Destination port (0.02), Dest. port count (0.01)
Suggested action: Isolate the source host: it is contacting many internal machines on admin ports.
```

## 4. Robustness under 8 weeks of drift - attacker evasion + benign shift (main scenario)

Seeds: 3. Mean ± std over seeds.

| Policy | Mean F1 (wk 1-8) | Final F1 (wk 8) | Worst-week F1 | Mean fidelity | Retrains | Windows labelled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No retraining | 0.919 ± 0.039 | 0.745 ± 0.086 | 0.745 ± 0.086 | 0.565 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Periodic (every 2 wk) | 0.988 ± 0.009 | 0.964 ± 0.042 | 0.954 ± 0.036 | 0.617 | 3.0 | 18.0 |
| EFDM (GNNExplainer fidelity) | 0.919 ± 0.039 | 0.745 ± 0.086 | 0.745 ± 0.086 | 0.565 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| EFDM-attn (cheap) | 0.919 ± 0.039 | 0.745 ± 0.086 | 0.745 ± 0.086 | 0.565 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| Confidence trigger | 0.970 ± 0.013 | 0.898 ± 0.112 | 0.869 ± 0.090 | 0.582 | 1.0 | 16.0 |
| Input-PSI trigger | 0.977 ± 0.015 | 0.918 ± 0.064 | 0.915 ± 0.060 | 0.573 | 1.7 | 13.0 |
| Label-monitored (oracle) | 0.984 ± 0.008 | 0.949 ± 0.033 | 0.941 ± 0.022 | 0.576 | 1.3 | 21.0 |

Static model, week 0 -> week 8: F1 1.000 -> 0.745; recall 1.000 -> 0.601; FPR 0.0002 -> 0.0000; GNNExplainer fidelity 0.568 -> 0.536.

Label-free drift signals on the static model. AUROC = separates weeks with real degradation (F1 down > 0.05 vs week 0) from healthy weeks, pooled over seeds (0.5 = chance, `nan` = no degraded weeks); rho = mean Spearman correlation with F1.

| Signal | AUROC | Spearman rho with F1 |
|---|---|---|
| EFDM: GNNExplainer fidelity | 0.790 | +0.376 |
| EFDM-attn: attention fidelity | 0.210 | -0.526 |
| Mean confidence | 0.835 | +0.720 |
| Input PSI (max over features) | 0.932 | -0.824 |
| Alert rate (|shift|) | 0.955 | -0.776 |

First week each monitor fires on the static model (thresholds calibrated on the clean validation period; `-` = never):

| Seed | F1 (needs labels) | EFDM | EFDM-attn | Confidence | PSI |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 5 | - | - | 7 | - |
| 1 | 5 | - | - | 6 | 3 |
| 2 | 3 | - | - | 3 | 4 |
